page: Amazon Web Services r6id.24xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8375C processor with 96 vCPUs (48 physical cores with 2 threads per core) operating at 3.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system provides 768.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, delivering an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. Attached storage includes 5,700 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage. Baseline network performance is rated at 38 Gbps. Acceleration hardware is not included, with a GPU count of zero.

Benchmark results show balanced compute and high multi-core throughput across parallel workloads. The server achieves a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 92,906.6 and a PassMark CPU score of 76,046.38, both ranking in the top 25%. Instruction-set-specific tests demonstrate strong cryptographic acceleration, reaching a top 10% PassMark CPU encryption score of 87,341.02 via AES-NI and VAES extensions. Single-thread processing remains moderate, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1,655.0 and stress-ng single-core score of 1,893.09 landing in the middle 50% tier.

Memory and caching subsystems demonstrate high operational throughput, showing uncached read bandwidth of 326.54 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 139.4 GB/sec on large 256 MB blocks. This dense memory footprint translates to 87.24 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a PassMark database operations metric of 29,751.11. Large language model text generation achieves 22.38 tokens/sec on 7B models and 2.81 tokens/sec on 70B models, reflecting CPU-bound inferencing limits despite high memory capacity.

Given the dense allocation of 768 GB of RAM combined with 5.7 TB of high-speed local NVMe storage and 96 vCPUs, the r6id.24xlarge offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy and disk-intensive deployments. It is suited for large in-memory databases like Redis or Memcached, transactional database clusters requiring high IOPS local caching, distributed big data processing, and large Clang software build farms.
description: Amazon Web Services r6id.24xlarge is a memory-optimized Nitro-based virtual instance driven by an Intel Xeon 8375C x86_64 processor. The configuration allocates 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores running at 3.5 GHz, paired with 768.0 GB of DDR4 memory and 5,700 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It provides a baseline network throughput of 38 Gbps and lacks discrete GPUs. Multi-threaded benchmark performance is consistently high, scoring 92,906.6 in stress-ng multi-core and 87,341.02 in PassMark encryption, supported by hardware AVX-512 and VAES instruction sets. Memory performance is substantial, sustaining 326.54 GB/sec read bandwidth and delivering 87.24 million Redis SET operations per second. With high memory density and extensive fast NVMe storage, this instance is suited for in-memory databases, large-scale data analytics pipelines, and I/O-intensive enterprise database engines.
